Name: Data Layers
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: Overlay the world with visual data like bee/Junimo/scarecrow/sprinkler coverage, hidden paths and warps, and more.
Description:
Overlay the world with visual data like bee/Junimo/scarecrow/sprinkler coverage, hidden paths and warps, and more. It automatically includes data from other mods if applicable.

**Translated into Chinese, English, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish ([translations welcome](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods#translating-the-mods)).**

![](https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png)
1. [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).
2. Install the mod through ModDrop (or unzip the download into `Stardew Valley/Mods`).
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

![](https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png)
* Compatible with...
  * Stardew Valley 1.5 or later;
  * Linux, macOS, and Windows;
  * single-player and multiplayer.
* No known mod conflicts.

Data Layers automatically supports these mods if they're installed:
* Automate — shows whether your machines are empty, processing, or ready to harvest.
* Better Junimos﻿ ﻿— shows custom Junimo hut range.
* Better Sprinklers﻿ — shows custom sprinkler range.
* Cobalt ﻿— shows cobalt sprinkler range.
* Line Sprinklers﻿ — shows custom sprinkler range.
* Pelican Fiber ﻿— shows coverage when building a Junimo hut or sprinkler through Pelican Fiber's menu.
* Prismatic Tools — shows prismatic sprinkler/scarecrow range.
* Simple Sprinkler — shows custom sprinkler range.

![](https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png)

Press `F2` to show the overlay, and then `[left CTRL]` and `[right CTRL]` to cycle between data layers (buttons configurable). For coverage layers (e.g. scarecrows or sprinklers), point at one with the cursor to see a blue border around that one's range and a green border around the coverage without it.

You can optionally [customise the options](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/DataLayers#configuration) (including keyboard/controller bindings).

Below are the current data layers.

### Accessible
Shows where you can walk and highlights warp tiles; useful for finding hidden paths and nooks, or testing custom maps.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/accessible.png)

### Buildable
Shows where you can construct buildings on the farm. Useful for spotting issues before you try to build at Robin's, or testing custom maps.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/buildable.png)

### Coverage: bee houses
Shows bee houses' flower search range.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/bee-houses.png)

### Coverage: Junimo huts
Shows Junimo hut coverage, and highlights crops they won't reach. Also works when placing a Junimo hut from the Wizard's build menu.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/junimo-huts.png)

### Coverage: scarecrows
Shows scarecrow coverage, and highlights unprotected crops. Also works on scarecrows being placed.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/scarecrows.png)

### Coverage: sprinklers
Shows sprinkler coverage, and highlights unsprinkled crops. Also works on sprinklers being placed.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/sprinklers.png)

### Crops: fertilised
Shows which crops have fertiliser applied.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/crops-fertilized.png)

### Crops: watered
Shows which crops have been watered today.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/crops-watered.png)

### Crops: water for paddy crops
Shows which tiles are close enough to water for paddy crops to get auto-watered and bonus growth.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/crops-paddy-water.png)

### Machine processing
Shows whether your machines are empty, processing, or finished. (You need to install [Automate](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063) for this layer to appear, but it'll work for machines that aren't being automated too.)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/machines.png)

### Tillable
Shows where you can till dirt with your hoe. Useful for planning crop layouts, or testing custom maps.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/tillable.png)

### Grid
The grid layer shows [tile borders](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Modder_Guide/Game_Fundamentals#Tiles) useful for planning layouts, calculating fishing distance, etc:

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/grid-layer.png)

You can optionally [edit the `config.json` file](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/DataLayers#configuration) to enable the grid for all layers instead:

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/grid-option.png)
